title: Orders for payment of money passed by Registrar of Copyrights and [1][Appellate Board] to
text:
75. Orders for payment of money passed by Registrar of Copyrights and [Appellate Board] to

be executable as a decree.—Every order made by the Registrar of Copyrights or the [Appellate Board]
under this Act for the payment of any money or by the High Court in any appeal against any such order of
the [Appellate Board] shall, on a certificate issued by the Registrar of Copyrights, the [Appellate Board]
or the Registrar of the High Court, as the case may be, be deemed to be a decree of a civil court and shall
be executable in the same manner as a decree of such court.
